question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and make `imsg` 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor, accepting required doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: The patch converts previously accepted persisted config and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; tests establish mechanics but cannot choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof covers one-turn split-send delivery and the older-version recovery message.

options.title: Accept the transition now
options.body: Merge with the current migration proof and dependency contract while explicitly owning the remaining delivery-proof uncertainty.

options.title: Defer retirement
options.body: Keep the current config and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the binary and config upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof covers one-turn split-send delivery and the older-version recovery message.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily the supported `imsg` release floor and OpenClaw’s operator upgrade policy.
